name: wraith-osint
description: WraithOSINT - Plataforma forense de inteligencia OSINT (desktop Electron + motor Python)
author: iwiels

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace desktop
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff check engine/ tests/ && node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff format --check engine/ tests/
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:py && npm run gen:sdk:check && npm run a11y:contrast && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run engine:build && npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop -- --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run engine:build && npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop -- --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run engine:build && npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop -- --linux
scripts.dist:all: npm run engine:build && npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop -- --win --mac --linux
